Continue pitching toward a top-down pinch while advancing toward the coin. Keep the fingers open and above the table.
Continue a smooth top-down approach in the left workspace, keeping clearance until the coin is centered in the wrist view.
Approach above the holder with the left gripper almost vertical; complete wrist alignment before descending to grasp.
Center the coin beneath the left fingers and finish the vertical orientation; descend cautiously toward the exposed coin edge.
Use wrist feedback to remove lateral error and align the jaws with the coin plane during a slow final descent.

Correct the remaining small lateral offset and close fully on the coin, holding pose until retention can be checked by lifting.

Coin is visibly clear of the holder and retained. Carry it leftward with added height to clear the bank, maintaining the vertical coin plane.
Translate toward the bank at clearance height and gently rotate the coin plane to match the visible slot direction.
Continue carrying the retained coin above the bank, preserving clearance and gradually matching the slot orientation.
Move above the bank slot at fixed height; the slot is currently obscured by the fingers, so final centering will use the next wrist view.

Pause descent to correct the visible lateral slot error and small angular mismatch; maintain secure coin retention.
Slot and coin are nearly aligned. Apply a small centering correction while lowering slowly, watching for rim contact.
Continue a cautious insertion approach with a millimeter lateral correction, preserving the coin's alignment with the narrow slot.

Fully open the fingers and allow the coin to settle into the slot before withdrawing. Verify release visually.
The coin has disappeared into the slot and the fingers are empty. Withdraw upward and back, beginning a continuous elbow-up return to origin.
Retract toward the original left-arm posture with the gripper open, maintaining elbow-up continuity and clearance from the bank.
Continue the smooth return toward origin, lowering only as the open gripper clears the bank.
Bring the left arm closer to its starting position and correct the small accumulated right-arm drift. Both grippers remain open.
Complete the controlled return to the original end-effector poses, keeping the arms separated and both grippers open.
